items.title: Mildred Major and Emma Zeno Interview, 1969-03-28
items.q: I'm interviewing Mildred Major and also her mother, Alice. Emma. Emma.

ctx.x: All right, today is March 28, 1969, and I'm interviewing Mildred Major and also her mother, Alice. Emma. Emma. Yeah. And all right, Mildred, what are your earliest memories of at home and where were you living and, you know, what can you remember at that time?
Well, I can remember very little, like I told you, Mandeville was the first place that I knew we lived. Yeah. I was rather small then.
